Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, alternating with contraction of fingers and toes
Comes with other symptoms.en: You experience sudden voice box spasms that alternate with cramping of the fingers and toes.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और साथ में उँगलियाँ व पैर की उँगलियाँ भी सिकुड़ने लगती हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur sath mein ungliyaan va pair ki ungliyaan bhi sikudne lagti hain.

Linked to bowel movement.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, cough, before the
Linked to bowel movement.en: The sudden voice box spasm happens just before a coughing fit starts.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: खाँसी शुरू होने से पहले गला अचानक भिंच जाता है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Khansi shuru hone se pehle gala achanak bhinch jata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, daily
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasms happen every day.
Linked to time of day.hi: हर दिन गला अचानक भिंचने और सांस रुकने की तकलीफ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Har din gala achanak bhinchne aur saans rukne ki taklif hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, night
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasms happen at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और सांस लेने में बहुत तकलीफ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur saans lene mein bahut taklif hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, night, midnight
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasms happen at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और सांस लेना मुश्किल हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur saans lena mushkil ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, night, midnight, to 7 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasms happen from midnight through to 7 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से सुबह 7 बजे तक गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और सांस रुक जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se subah 7 baje tak gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur saans ruk jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, night, midnight, waking out of sound sleep
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasm wakes you from a deep sleep at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को गहरी नींद से अचानक जागने पर गला भिंच जाता है और सांस नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko gahri neend se achanak jagne par gala bhinch jata hai aur saans nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, sleep
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasms are related to sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद के दौरान गला अचानक भिंचने और सांस रुकने की तकलीफ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend ke dauran gala achanak bhinchne aur saans rukne ki taklif hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, sleep, during
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasms happen while you are asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद में गला भिंच जाता है और सांस लेने में बहुत परेशानी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend mein gala bhinch jata hai aur saans lene mein bahut pareshani hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, sleep, on falling asleep
Linked to time of day.en: The sudden voice box spasm happens just as you are falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद आते समय गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और सांस रुक जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend ate samay gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur saans ruk jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, exhalation, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: The sudden voice box spasm is triggered when you breathe out.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: साँस छोड़ते समय गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और सांस लेना मुश्किल हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Saans chhodte samay gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur saans lena mushkil ho jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, swallowing
Triggered by specific actions.en: Swallowing triggers a sudden voice box spasm.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलते समय गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और सांस लेना मुश्किल हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch niglte samay gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur saans lena mushkil ho jata hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, laryngismus stridulus, warm room
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in a warm room brings on a sudden voice box spasm.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में रहने पर गला अचानक भिंच जाता है और सांस रुक जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm kamre mein rahne par gala achanak bhinch jata hai aur saans ruk jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, lump, behind larynx that compels swallowing
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel a lump just behind your voice box that keeps making you swallow.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) के पीछे कुछ अटका हुआ लगता है जिसकी वजह से बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke peeche kuch atka hua lagta hai jiski wajah se bar bar niglna padta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, lump, throat-pit
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel a lump sensation in the hollow at the base of your throat (the throat pit).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के निचले गड्ढे (कंठमूल/थ्रोट-पिट) में कुछ अटका हुआ महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke niche gadhe mein kuch atka hua mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, membrane, seems to move about in larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel as though a membrane or film is moving around inside your voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे गले (स्वरयंत्र) के अंदर झिल्ली इधर-उधर हिलती रहती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise gale (svarayantri) ke andar jhilli idhar-udhar hilti rahti hai.

Discharge.en: There is mucus (phlegm) sitting in your voice box.
Discharge.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale (svarayantri) mein balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, blood-streaked
Discharge.en: The mucus in your voice box is streaked with blood.
Discharge.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में खून की धारियों वाला बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale (svarayantri) mein khun ki dhariyon wala balgam aata hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, blue
Discharge.en: The mucus in your voice box looks blue in color.
Discharge.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) से नीले रंग का बलगम निकलता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale (svarayantri) se nile rang ka balgam nikalata hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, cold air, in
Discharge.en: The mucus in your voice box builds up when you breathe cold air.
Discharge.hi: ठंडी हवा में गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Discharge.roman: Thandi hava mein gale (svarayantri) mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, copious
Discharge.en: There is a large amount of mucus building up in your voice box.
Discharge.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बहुत ज़्यादा बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale (svarayantri) mein bahut zyada balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, cough, after each paroxysmal
Discharge.en: Mucus appears in your voice box after each coughing fit.
Discharge.hi: खाँसी का एक-एक दौरा आने के बाद गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम आ जाता है।
Discharge.roman: Khansi ka ek-ek daura aane ke baad gale (svarayantri) mein balgam aa jata hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, ejected with difficulty
Discharge.en: The mucus in your voice box is very hard to bring up and clear.
Discharge.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) से बलगम बहुत मुश्किल से निकलता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale (svarayantri) se balgam bahut mushkil se nikalata hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, evening
Discharge.en: Mucus builds up in your voice box in the evening.
Discharge.hi: शाम के समय गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Discharge.roman: Shaam ke samay gale (svarayantri) mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, green
Discharge.en: The mucus in your voice box is green in color.
Discharge.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) से हरे रंग का बलगम निकलता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale (svarayantri) se hare rang ka balgam nikalata hai.

Discharge.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, morning
Discharge.en: Mucus builds up in your voice box in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह के समय गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Subah ke samay gale (svarayantri) mein balgam jama rahta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, eating, after
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Mucus builds up in your voice box after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad gale (svarayantri) mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, laughing
Triggered by specific actions.en: Laughing brings up mucus from your voice box.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हँसने पर गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम आ जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hansne par gale (svarayantri) mein balgam aa jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, stooping, comes up when
Triggered by specific actions.en: Mucus comes up into the throat/voice box area when bending forward.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: झुकने पर गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम ऊपर आ जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jhukne par gale mein balgam upar aa jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, talking, from
Triggered by specific actions.en: Talking causes mucus to build up in the throat/voice box area.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बात करने पर गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम आ जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Baat karne par gale mein balgam aa jata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, morning, rising, after
Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the throat/voice box area in the morning, after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad gale (svarayantri) mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, morning, waking, on
Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the throat/voice box area upon waking in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह जागने पर गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा मिलता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah jagne par gale mein balgam jama milta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, night
Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the throat/voice box area at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, night, speaking, on
Linked to time of day.en: Mucus appears in the throat/voice box area at night when speaking.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बात करने पर गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम आ जाता है।

Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम खड़खड़ाहट की आवाज़ के साथ महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ke samay gale mein balgam khadkhadaht ki awaz ke saath mehsus hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the windpipe in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सांस की नली (श्वासनली) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko sans ki nali mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, trachea, forenoon
Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the windpipe during the late morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर से पहले (पूर्वाह्न में) सांस की नली (श्वासनली) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar se pehle sans ki nali mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the windpipe in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय सांस की नली (श्वासनली) में बलगम जमा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay sans ki nali mein balgam jama rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, trachea, night
Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the windpipe at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को सांस की नली (श्वासनली) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko sans ki nali mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, overheated, from being
Triggered by specific situations.en: Mucus builds up in the throat/voice box area after becoming overheated.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: शरीर ज़्यादा गर्म हो जाने पर गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Sharir zyada garm ho jane par gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, rattling
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a rattling mucus in the throat/voice box area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में बलगम खड़खड़ाहट की आवाज़ के साथ महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein balgam khadkhadaht ki awaz ke saath mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, larynx, salty
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The mucus in the throat/voice box area has a salty taste.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) से निकलने वाला बलगम नमकीन स्वाद का होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale se nikalne wala balgam namkeen swad ka hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, trachea, ascending and descending
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Mucus in the windpipe moves up and down.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सांस की नली (श्वासनली) में बलगम ऊपर-नीचे चढ़ता-उतरता महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sans ki nali mein balgam upar-neeche chadta-utarta mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, trachea, ejected with difficulty
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Mucus in the windpipe is very hard to cough up or clear.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सांस की नली (श्वासनली) से बलगम बहुत मुश्किल से निकलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sans ki nali se balgam bahut mushkil se nikalta hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, mucus, trachea
General.en: There is mucus in the windpipe.
General.hi: सांस की नली (श्वासनली) में बलगम जमा रहता है।
General.roman: Sans ki nali mein balgam jama rehta hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, boring, larynx
Type of pain.en: There is a boring, drilling-type pain in the voice box.
Type of pain.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में अंदर की तरफ ड्रिल जैसा चुभने वाला दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale (svaryantra) mein andar ki taraf drill jaisa chubhne wala dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, burning
Type of pain.en: There is a burning pain in the throat/voice box or windpipe area.

Type of pain.roman: Gale aur sans ki nali mein jalan hoti hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, burning, larynx
Type of pain.en: There is a burning pain in the voice box.
Type of pain.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में जलन का दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale (svaryantra) mein jalan ka dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, burning, trachea
Type of pain.en: There is a burning pain in the windpipe.
Type of pain.hi: सांस की नली (ट्रेकिया) में जलन महसूस होती है।
Type of pain.roman: Sans ki nali (trakia) mein jalan mehsus hoti hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, bursting
Type of pain.en: There is a bursting pain in the throat/voice box or windpipe area.
Type of pain.hi: गले में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे कुछ फट रहा हो।
Type of pain.roman: Gale mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kuch fat raha ho.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, contractive
Type of pain.en: There is a contracting or squeezing pain in the throat/voice box or windpipe area.

Type of pain.roman: Gale mein khinchhav jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, cutting
Type of pain.en: There is a cutting pain in the throat/voice box or windpipe area.
Type of pain.hi: गले में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale mein katne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, cutting, larynx
Type of pain.en: There is a cutting pain in the voice box.
Type of pain.hi: स्वरयंत्र (गले की नली) में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Swarayant (gale ki nali) mein katne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, lancinating, trachea
Type of pain.en: There is a stabbing, lancinating pain in the windpipe.
Type of pain.hi: सांस की नली में चुभने जैसा तेज दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Sans ki nali mein chubhne jaisa tez dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, pain, larynx
Type of pain.en: There is pain in the voice box.
Type of pain.hi: गले की नली (स्वरयंत्र) में दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale ki nali (swarayant) mein dard hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a scraping sensation that makes you want to clear your throat when talking.

Triggered by specific situations.en: The voice box feels sensitive to the sound of a piano.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, sulphur vapor, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The throat and airway feel as though breathing in sulphur fumes.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, tickling in the air passages, morning
Linked to time of day.en: There is a tickling feeling in the breathing passages in the morning.

Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay sans ki nali mein gudgudi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khuli hawa mein tahalne par sans ki nali mein gudgudi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.roman: Bayin karavat letne par sans ki nali mein gudgudi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down makes the tickling feeling in the breathing passages worse.

Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par sans ki nali ki gudgudi badh jati hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice sounds like a bark.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज कुत्ते के भौंकने जैसी निकलती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Awaaz kutte ke bhaunke jaisi niklti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has become unusually deep and low-pitched, like a bass voice.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज बहुत मोटी और गहरी हो गई है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Awaaz bahut moti aur gehri ho gayi hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice sounds thin and wavering, like a bleat.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज बकरी जैसी मिमियाती हुई निकलती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Awaaz bakri jaisi mimiati hui niklti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice keeps breaking or cracking when speaking.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज बीच-बीच में टूट जाती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Awaaz beech-beech mein tut jati hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, broken, attempting to sing high, when
Sounds & movement.en: The voice breaks or cracks when trying to sing high notes.
Sounds & movement.hi: ऊँचे सुर में गाने की कोशिश करते समय आवाज टूट जाती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Unche sur mein gane ki koshish karte samay awaaz tut jati hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice keeps changing pitch or quality on its own.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज का सुर बार-बार बदलता रहता है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Awaaz ka sur bar-bar badalta rehta hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has changed and no longer sounds normal.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज पहले जैसी नहीं रही, बदल गई है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Awaaz pehle jaisi nahi rahi, badal gayi hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice cracks or breaks unexpectedly.
Sounds & movement.hi: बोलते समय आवाज फटी-फटी निकलती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: bolte samay awaaz phatti-phatti niklti hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, cracked, evening
Sounds & movement.en: The voice cracks or breaks in the evening.
Sounds & movement.hi: शाम को आवाज फटी-फटी हो जाती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: shaam ko awaaz phatti-phatti ho jati hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, cracked, singing, when
Sounds & movement.en: The voice cracks or breaks when singing.
Sounds & movement.hi: गाते समय आवाज फट जाती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: gate samay awaaz phat jati hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has a deep, croaking quality.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज मेंढक जैसी टर्राती हुई निकलती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz mendak jaisi tarrati hui niklti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice sounds croupy — harsh and rough like in croup.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज क्रुप (खाँसी वाला रोग) जैसी कड़कदार निकलती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz krup jaisi kadkdar niklti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has a crowing or high-pitched crowing sound.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज मुर्गे की बाँग जैसी ऊँची और कड़क निकलती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz murge ki bang jaisi unchi aur kadak niklti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has become unusually deep.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज बहुत गहरी और भारी हो गई है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz bahut gehri aur bhari ho gayi hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, finer than usual
Sounds & movement.en: The voice is thinner or higher-pitched than usual.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज सामान्य से पतली और बारीक हो गई है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz samanya se patli aur barik ho gayi hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has a guttural, throaty quality.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज गले के पीछे से निकलने वाली गहरी और भारी आवाज जैसी हो गई है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz gale ke piche se nikalne wali gehri aur bhari awaaz jaisi ho gayi hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has become higher-pitched than normal.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज सामान्य से ऊँची हो गई है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz samanya se unchi ho gayi hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, higher, hawking, after
Sounds & movement.en: The voice becomes higher-pitched after clearing the throat.
Sounds & movement.hi: गला साफ करने के बाद आवाज थोड़ी ऊँची हो जाती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: gala saaf karne ke baad awaaz thodi unchi ho jati hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice has a hissing quality.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज साँप की फुफकार जैसी सीटी मारती हुई निकलती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz sanp ki fukar jaisi siti marti hui niklti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The voice is hoarse.
Sounds & movement.hi: आवाज बैठ गई है (भारीपन या खराश के साथ)।
Sounds & movement.roman: awaaz baith gayi hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, deep, eating, after
Linked to eating/digestion.en: The voice becomes unusually deep after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद आवाज और गहरी हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: khana khane ke baad awaaz aur gehri ho jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, dinner, after amel.
Linked to eating/digestion.en: The hoarseness gets better after eating dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात का खाना खाने के बाद आवाज की बैठन कम हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khane ke baad awaaz ki baithan kam ho jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, eating, after
Linked to eating/digestion.en: My voice becomes hoarse after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The voice becomes unusually deep in cold, damp outdoor air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: नम और ठंडी हवा में आवाज और गहरी हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: nam aur thandi hava mein awaaz aur gehri ho jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: khuli hava mein jane par awaaz aur gehri ho jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, air

Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: हवा लगने से आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: hava lagne se awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, air, cold
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Cold air makes the voice hoarse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा लगने से आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa lagne se awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, air, draft of
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A draft of air makes the voice hoarse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: हवा का झोंका लगने से आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Hawa ka jhonka lagne se awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, air, dry
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Dry air makes the voice hoarse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: सूखी हवा से आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sukhi hawa se awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, air, open
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in the open air affects the voice, making it hoarse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane se awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, air, open, in agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in the open air makes the hoarseness worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने पर आवाज और बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane par awaaz aur baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, air, open, in, amel.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in the open air makes the hoarseness better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने पर बैठी हुई आवाज में सुधार होता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane par baithi hui awaaz mein sudhaar hota hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, cold, damp weather
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Cold, damp weather makes the voice hoarse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडे और नम मौसम में आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thande aur nam mausam mein awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, damp weather, in
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Damp weather makes the voice hoarse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: नम मौसम में आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Nam mausam mein awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, heat, during
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My voice becomes hoarse when I have a fever or feel overheated with heat.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बुखार की गर्मी के दौरान आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bukhar ki garmi ke dauran awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, overheated, from being
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My voice becomes hoarse after getting overheated.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ज्यादा गर्मी लगने से आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Zyada garmi lagne se awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, spring, in
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My voice becomes hoarse in the spring season.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बसंत के मौसम में आवाज़ बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Basant ke mausam mein awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, walking, against the wind
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My voice becomes hoarse when I walk against the wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: हवा के विरुद्ध चलने पर आवाज़ बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: hawa ke virudh chalne par awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, warm room
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My voice becomes hoarse in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में रहने पर आवाज़ बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: garm kamre mein rehne par awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, warm room, going into open air from warm room
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My voice becomes hoarse when I go out of a warm room into the open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे से बाहर खुली हवा में जाने पर आवाज़ बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: garm kamre se bahar khuli hawa mein jane par awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, warm, wet weather agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My hoarseness gets worse in warm, wet weather.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म और नम मौसम में आवाज़ की बैठन बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: garm aur nam mausam mein awaaz ki baithna badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, wet, after getting
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: My voice becomes hoarse after getting wet.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: भीगने के बाद आवाज़ बैठ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: bhigne ke baad awaaz baith jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalne par awaaz chali jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhumrapan se awaaz ki khurdrahatt kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Baat karne ke baad awaaz kamzor ho jati hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, children, in
General.en: The voice is hoarse in children.
General.hi: बच्चों में आवाज बैठ जाती है।
General.roman: Bachchon mein awaaz baith jati hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, paroxysmal
General.en: My hoarseness comes on in sudden attacks or episodes.
General.hi: आवाज अचानक दौरे की तरह बैठ जाती है।
General.roman: Awaaz achanak daure ki tarah baith jati hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, periodical
General.en: My hoarseness comes and goes in a regular or recurring pattern.
General.hi: आवाज एक नियमित अंतराल पर बार-बार बैठती है।
General.roman: Awaaz ek niyamit antral par bar-bar baithti hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, speech, preventing
General.en: My hoarseness is so bad that I cannot speak properly.
General.hi: आवाज़ इतनी बैठी हुई है कि बोल भी नहीं पा रहा/पा रही हूँ।
General.roman: Awaaz itni baithi hui hai ki bol bhi nahi pa raha pा rahi hoon.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, sudden
General.en: My voice suddenly becomes hoarse without warning.
General.hi: आवाज़ अचानक बैठ गई।
General.roman: Awaaz achanak baith gayi.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost
General.en: I have completely lost my voice.
General.hi: आवाज़ बिल्कुल चली गई है।
General.roman: awaaz bilkul chali gai hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, intermittent in singers
General.en: I am a singer whose voice cuts out intermittently.
General.hi: गायकों की आवाज़ बीच-बीच में जाती रहती है।
General.roman: gaykon ki awaaz beech-beech mein jati rahti hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, momentarily
General.en: My voice disappears only for a moment and then comes back.
General.hi: आवाज़ बस कुछ पलों के लिए चली जाती है।
General.roman: awaaz bas kuch palon ke liye chali jati hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, periodic
General.en: I lose my voice in a regular, recurring pattern.
General.hi: आवाज़ कभी-कभी (एक निश्चित समय पर) जाती है।
General.roman: Awaaz kabhi-kabhi (ek nischit samay par) jati hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, singers
General.en: Singers lose their voice completely.
General.hi: गायकों की आवाज़ चली जाती है।
General.roman: Gaykon ki awaaz chali jati hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, sudden
General.en: My voice is suddenly and completely lost without warning.
General.hi: आवाज़ अचानक चली गई है।
General.roman: Awaaz achanak chali gayi hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, whining
General.en: Your voice sounds whiny or has a whining quality.
General.hi: मेरी आवाज़ रोने जैसी या कराहती हुई निकलती है।
General.roman: Meri awaaz rone jaisi ya karahti hui niklti hai.

General.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, whispering
General.en: You can only speak in a whisper — your voice has little or no strength behind it.
General.hi: मेरी आवाज़ बहुत धीमी हो गई है, जैसे फुसफुसाहट में बोल रहा/रही हूँ।
General.roman: Meri awaaz bahut dhimi ho gyi hai, jaise phusphusaht mein bol raha/rahi hoon.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, chill, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: The voice becomes hoarse during a shivering chill.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) के दौरान आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagne (kapkapi) ke dauran awaaz baith jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, coryza, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: The voice is hoarse during a head cold with a runny nose.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जुकाम के दौरान आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Jukam ke dauran awaaz baith jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, croup, after
Comes with other symptoms.en: The voice remains hoarse after a bout of croup.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: क्रुप (काली खाँसी जैसी बीमारी) के बाद आवाज बैठ गई है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Croup (kali khansi jaisi bimari) ke baad awaaz baith gayi hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, measles, after
Comes with other symptoms.en: My voice has been hoarse ever since I had measles.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खसरे के बाद आवाज बैठ गई है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khasre ke baad awaaz baith gayi hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, cough, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: I lose my voice along with a cough.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खाँसी के साथ आवाज़ चली गई है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: khansi ke saath awaaz chali gayi hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, epilepsy, before
Comes with other symptoms.en: I lose my voice just before a seizure (fit).
Comes with other symptoms.hi: मिर्गी का दौरा आने से पहले आवाज़ चली जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: mirgi ka daura aane se pehle awaaz chali jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, nasal, catarrhal
Comes with other symptoms.en: My voice sounds nasal due to congestion or catarrh in my nose.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: नाक में सर्दी-जुकाम के कारण आवाज़ नाक से निकलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Nak mein sardi-jukam ke karan awaaz nak se niklti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, menses
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: My voice becomes hoarse around the time of my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के समय आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke samay awaaz baith jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, menses, before
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: My voice becomes hoarse before my menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle awaaz baith jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: My voice becomes hoarse during my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान आवाज बैठी रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran awaaz baithi rehti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, morning, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: My voice is hoarse in the morning during my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: सुबह माहवारी के दौरान आवाज बैठी रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Subah mahwari ke dauran awaaz baithi rehti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: I lose my voice during my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान आवाज़ चली जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke dauran awaaz chali jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, weak, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: My voice becomes weak during my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान आवाज़ कमज़ोर हो जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ke dauran awaaz kamzor ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, whining, menses, after
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your voice takes on a whining quality after your menstrual period ends.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के बाद मेरी आवाज़ रोने जैसी या कराहती हुई हो जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke baad meri awaaz rone jaisi ya karahti hui ho jati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, mucus in larynx
Linked to a specific organ.en: My voice is hoarse because of mucus sitting in my throat or voice box.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले में बलगम जमने की वजह से आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale mein balgam jamne ki wajah se awaaz baith jati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, mucus in larynx, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: I lose my voice because of mucus collecting in my throat or voice box.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले में बलगम आने से आवाज़ चली जाती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: gale mein balgam aane se awaaz chali jati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, paralysis, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: I have lost my voice due to paralysis of the voice box.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: लकवे (पैरालिसिस) के कारण आवाज़ चली गई है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: lakwe (paralysis) ke karan awaaz chali gayi hai.

Type of pain.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, painful
Type of pain.en: My voice is hoarse and it hurts to speak.
Type of pain.hi: आवाज बैठने के साथ-साथ दर्द भी होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Awaaz baitne ke saath-saath dard bhi hota hai.

General sensation.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, painless
General sensation.en: My voice is hoarse but it does not hurt.
General sensation.hi: आवाज बैठी हुई है लेकिन कोई दर्द नहीं है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz baithi hui hai lekin koi dard nahi hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds husky or rough and scratchy.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ भारी और कर्कश हो गई है।
General sensation.roman: awaaz bhari aur karkash ho gai hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds unclear or hard for others to understand.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ साफ नहीं निकलती, अस्पष्ट लगती है।
General sensation.roman: awaaz saaf nahi niklti, aspasht lagti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds stiff or unable to change pitch naturally.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ अकड़ी हुई सी है, ऊँची-नीची नहीं होती।
General sensation.roman: awaaz akdi hui si hai, unchi-nichi nahi hoti.

General sensation.en: My voice keeps getting cut off or interrupted while I speak.
General sensation.hi: बोलते-बोलते आवाज़ बीच में रुक जाती है।
General sensation.roman: bolte-bolte awaaz bich mein ruk jati hai.

General sensation.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, painless
General sensation.en: I have lost my voice but it does not hurt.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ बिना किसी दर्द के चली गई है।
General sensation.roman: awaaz bina kisi dard ke chali gayi hai.

General sensation.en: My voice comes out unusually loud.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ बहुत ऊँची और तेज़ निकलती है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz bahut unchi aur tez niklti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice is very low or quiet.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ बहुत धीमी हो गई है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz bahut dhimi ho gayi hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds muffled, as if something is blocking it.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ दबी-दबी और घुटी हुई सी लगती है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz dabi-dabi aur ghuti hui si lagti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds nasal, as if I am speaking through my nose.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ नाक से निकलती है (नकियाती आवाज़)।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz nak se niklti hai (nakiyati awaaz).

General sensation.en: My voice sounds high-pitched and thin, like a pipe or whistle.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ पतली और चीखती हुई सी निकलती है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz patli aur chikti hui si niklti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice is unusually powerful or strong.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ बहुत तेज़ और दमदार है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz bahut tez aur damdaar hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds rough or grating.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ खुरदरी और कड़कड़ाती हुई है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz khurdri aur kadkadati hui hai.

General sensation.en: My voice comes out as a shriek or scream.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ चीख जैसी निकलती है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz chikh jaisi niklti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice comes out as a squeak.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ चीं-चीं जैसी या किर्र-किर्र जैसी निकलती है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz chin-chin jaisi ya kirr-kirr jaisi niklti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds flat and expressionless, with no tone or resonance.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ में कोई जोश या ताकत नहीं है, बेजान सी लगती है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz mein koi josh ya taakat nahi hai, bejan si lagti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice sounds shaky or trembling when I speak.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ काँपती हुई निकलती है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz kaapti hui niklti hai.

General sensation.en: My voice is weak and faint.
General sensation.hi: आवाज़ बहुत कमज़ोर हो गई है।
General sensation.roman: Awaaz bahut kamzor ho gayi hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, rising
Linked to posture/position.en: My voice is hoarse when I first get up (rising from rest or sleep).
Linked to posture/position.hi: उठने (खड़े होने) पर आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Uthne khde hone par awaaz baith jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, rising, after
Linked to posture/position.en: My voice is hoarse after I get up and start moving around.
Linked to posture/position.hi: उठने के बाद आवाज बैठ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Uthne ke baad awaaz baith jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hoarseness, rising, from bed amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: My hoarseness gets better once I get out of bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर से उठने पर बैठी हुई आवाज में सुधार होता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bistar se uthne par baithi hui awaaz mein sudhaar hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, hollow
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My voice sounds hollow or empty.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: आवाज़ खोखली सुनाई देती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: awaaz khokli sunai deti hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, anger, after
Linked to emotion/excitement.en: I lost my voice after an episode of anger.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: गुस्से के बाद आवाज़ चली गई है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: gusse ke baad awaaz chali gai hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, fright, from
Linked to emotion/excitement.en: I lost my voice after a fright or sudden scare.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: डर या घबराहट से आवाज़ चली गई है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: dar ya ghabrahat se awaaz chali gayi hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, weak, anger, after
Linked to emotion/excitement.en: My voice becomes weak after an episode of anger.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: गुस्से के बाद आवाज़ कमज़ोर हो गई है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Gusse ke baad awaaz kamzor ho gayi hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, drinking cold water when overheated
Triggered by specific situations.en: I lost my voice after drinking cold water when I was overheated.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: शरीर गर्म होने पर ठंडा पानी पीने से आवाज़ चली गई है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: sharir garm hone par thanda pani pene se awaaz chali gayi hai.

Linked to mood/emotion.path: Larynx and trachea, voice, lost, hysterical
Linked to mood/emotion.en: I lose my voice suddenly due to an emotional or nervous reaction (hysterical).
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: हिस्टीरिया (घबराहट के दौरे) के कारण आवाज़ चली गई है।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: hysteria (ghabrahat ke daure) ke karan awaaz chali gayi hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Larynx and trachea, whistling, after lying down
Linked to posture/position.en: Your throat or windpipe produces a whistling sound after you lie down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने के बाद गले या साँस की नली से सीटी जैसी आवाज़ आने लगती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne ke baad gale ya saans ki nali se siti jaisi awaaz aane lgti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Larynx and trachea, whistling, lying on left side
Linked to posture/position.en: Your throat or windpipe produces a whistling sound when you lie on your left side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बाईं करवट लेटने पर गले या साँस की नली से सीटी जैसी आवाज़ आने लगती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bain karavat letne par gale ya saans ki nali se siti jaisi awaaz aane lgti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Larynx and trachea, whistling, evening
Linked to time of day.en: Your throat or windpipe produces a whistling sound in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय गले या साँस की नली से सीटी जैसी आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay gale ya saans ki nali se siti jaisi awaaz aati hai.
